column3: Mojo writes the exponent sign: 1e+23 where Mojito writes 1e23
Float16 renders at single precision upstream (0.7998047), at double precision in Mojito (0.7998046875)
Float32 renders at its own precision upstream (0.1), at double precision in Mojito (0.10000000149011612)
Float32 lanes, same shape as pliron_float32_semantics
a shift past the bit width: Mojo prints 7, Mojito 51102306
vector shifts disagree wholesale, including shifts past the lane width
signed floordiv at the type minimum: Mojo 0, Mojito -128
the owner of an interior `unsafe_ptr()` is destroyed before the read through it in Mojito (drop 9 before held 9); roadmap R1155
String subscript yields a character upstream (h), an Int in Mojito (104)
the raised-error text differs: DictKeyError[String]() vs "missing key"
reflection prints <unprintable> upstream where Mojito prints the element types
upstream's TString holds references and prints the current value (x=2); Mojito snapshots at creation (x=1), new at the 2026-10-17 re-pin; roadmap R1130
a temporary handed to a `var *xs` collector runs its move initializer upstream (i 1009 1); Mojito hands its storage over (i 9 1); roadmap R1131
